crossRefs.note: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.”

translations.web: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
translations.bsb: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.
translations.kjv: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale
translations.asv: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
